verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a team workspace product like Notion, but the evidence pack never documents a whiteboard or canvas feature. The only nearby items are integrations for viewing and sharing Canva or Sketch designs inside Notion. Those are third-party embeds, an adjacent feature, not a first-party shared whiteboard, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
